topics.title: Emphatic Cleft Constructions (Phrases Clivées : c'est... qui / que, ce qui... c'est, ce que... c'est)
topics.objective: Form, analyze, and apply emphatic cleft sentences (*c'est... qui*, *c'est... que*, *ce qui... c'est*, *ce que... c'est*, *ce dont... c'est*) to highlight sentence elements (subject, direct object, prepositional/adverbial complement) and establish contrastive focus in written and spoken discourse.
topics.spacy_pattern:
# Pattern 1: Standard Cleft (c'est / ce sont + [Focus Element] + qui / que / qu')
pattern_cleft_standard = [
    {"LOWER": {"IN": ["c'", "ce"]}},
    {"LEMMA": "être", "POS": {"IN": ["AUX", "VERB"]}},
    {"OP": "+"},  # Intermediate focused element (noun phrase, pronoun, prepositional phrase, adverb)
    {"LOWER": {"IN": ["qui", "que", "qu'"]}, "POS": {"IN": ["PRON", "SCONJ"]}}
]

# Pattern 2: Pseudo-cleft / Reversed Cleft (ce qui / ce que / ce dont ... c'est / ce sont)
pattern_pseudo_cleft = [
    {"LOWER": "ce"},
    {"LOWER": {"IN": ["qui", "que", "qu'", "dont"]}},
    {"OP": "+"},
    {"LOWER": {"IN": ["c'", "ce"]}},
    {"LEMMA": "être", "POS": {"IN": ["AUX", "VERB"]}}
]
